expect: re-enabled any recurring tasks present in project

contested.subject: unarchiveProject
contested.detail: The draft claims all recurring tasks in the project are re-enabled, but the spec only resumes those with endedByArchiving true and explicitly leaves directly-ended ones ended.
contested.quote: A RecurringTask ended directly via endRecurrence (endedByArchiving false) is left ended — unarchiveProject does not resume it.
